title: Conn v1 shared definitions
description: Reusable value definitions referenced by Conn v1 protocol records. This document is not a record schema.

uuidv7.description: Canonical lowercase UUID version 7 with the RFC 9562 variant.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a Z offset and at most microsecond precision, matching PostgreSQL storage. Calendar validity is checked by the parser that consumes it.

revision.description: Aggregate revision number. Revisions begin at 1.

eventSequence.description: Project-scoped event cursor. The maximum is the largest integer represented exactly by JavaScript clients.

key.description: Lowercase slug used for stable human-readable references within one record.

noNul.description: Text without U+0000, which PostgreSQL text cannot store. Every free-text definition includes it.

title.description: Plain-text title containing at least one non-whitespace character.

markdown.description: Untrusted Markdown. Renderers must sanitize it.

httpUri.description: Absolute http or https URI. Non-ASCII characters must be percent-encoded.
